summary: elevator / office elevator landing doors: mechanism_cannot_work; missing_hardware

findings.description: The task is 'unlock_open_traverse', which requires the door to move, but the primary joint's whole range is 2.00 mm. A MuJoCo joint range is static: releasing the interlock cannot widen it, so the door can never open. The three pose panels are identical.

The caption names operator elevator_none, and no geom on the door carries the 'operator' semantic - the part is drawn (as latch/lock/decor) but nothing the benchmark or the viewer reads as the operator.
